title: pilosella brachiata subsp. sabranskyi
intro: Pilosella brachiata subsp. sabranskyi, commonly known as Sabrany's pilosella, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant is primarily used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella brachiata subsp. sabranskyi include anti-rheumatic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-allergic properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and eczema. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects are flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
